scope: Avoid copying completed DXF modeler geometry into an adapter that supports the existing rvalue callback.
Verify move dispatch and legacy const-reference callback fallback.

changes.implementation: dxfRW::processModelerGeometry now calls addModelerGeometry(std::move(geom)). The in-tree dx_iface rvalue overload moves into the block; the DRW_Interface default rvalue overload remains compatible with legacy const-reference implementations.
changes.generatedTest: A generated ASCII DXF containing a minimal 3DSOLID modeler carrier is parsed by a probe overriding both callback overloads. It asserts the rvalue overload, not the const-reference overload, is invoked and the adapter retains the entity. The existing direct move/fallback selector tests legacy forwarding.

nonClaims: This removes one DXF adapter copy; it does not change parser semantics or DWG behavior.
